THE Governor is pleased to order the publication of the following English translation of notification
no. 786/IX-2–2020-03 Seema vistar-19 dated December 4, 2020 for general information :
No. 786/IX-2–2020-03 Seema vistar-19
Dated Lucknow, December 2, 2020
The following draft notification, which the Governor proposes to issue in exercise of the powers
under clause (2) of Article 243-Q of the Constitution read with sub-section(2) of section 3 of the Uttar
Pradesh Municipalities Act, 1916 (U.P. Act no.2 of 1916) hereinafter referred to as the said act, for
including the areas specified in Schedule-I below in the smaller urban area of Municipal Council Kairana,
district Shamli is hereby published for information of all concerned and with a view to inviting objections
and suggestions in respect thereof as required under sub- section(1) of section 4 of the said Act.
2. Objections and suggestions, if any, with respect to the proposed notification should be sent in
writing addressed to the Pramukh Sachiv, Nagar Vikas Anubhag-2, Uttar Pradesh Shasan, Bapu Bhawan,
Lucknow. Only those objections and suggestions which are received within fifteen days from the date of
publication of this notification in the Gazette shall be taken into consideration.
DRAFT NOTIFICATION
IN exercise of the powers under clause (2) of Article 243-Q of the Constitution read with sub-
section (2) of section 3 of the Uttar Pradesh Municipalities Act, 1916 (U.P Act no. 2 of 1916), the
Governor is pleased to specify that the area mentioned in Schedule-I below shall be included in the
smaller urban area of Municipal Council Kairana, district Shamli for the purposes of Part IX A of the
Constitution and is further pleased to notify under clause (d) of Article 243-P of the Constitution that the
area specified in Schedule-II below shall be the territorial area of the said Municipal Council Kairana,
district Shamli with effect from the date of publication of this notification in the Gazette.
